name: Hommies
author: Ayan De
description: Hommie, a floating companion that watches your coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Omacode, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Grok Build) and lets you approve permissions, answer questions, and see when turns finish.

barWidget.description: Answer coding-agent questions and approvals from the bar, or mirror them while answering in the native CLI.

schema.label: Answer agent questions in
schema.description: Top bar lets you answer Claude, OpenCode, Omacode, Antigravity, and Grok questions here (Claude, Antigravity, and Grok wait for the bar; OpenCode and Omacode accept whichever answer comes first). Claude CLI (applies to every agent) mirrors the question in the bar while the agent's own prompt owns the answer.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Show a system notification for each new permission, question, waiting reply, or finished turn.

schema.label: Sounds
schema.description: Play a short chime for new permissions and questions, failed turns, and finished turns (pw-play or paplay).
